goal: Repair required skill interface descriptions after ordinary ChatGPT reports workflow-orchestrator unavailable.
authorization: Continuation of the owner's requested full-startup repair; standing paired GitHub and existing-plugin update authorization.
confirmed_source_defect: 14 included agents/openai.yaml files omit interface.short_description, which current OpenAI plugin submission checks require when the file is included.
host_cause: Unknown. The same skill is present and readable in this Work catalog. The owner supplies an ordinary-ChatGPT missing-skill/Resource-not-found report, without raw tool arguments or resource-list results.
allowed_changes: Add only missing short_description fields; extend the existing canonical metadata guard and negative tests; update metadata standard and release records.
exclusions: Every SKILL.md instruction body and frontmatter
Skill IDs and existing display names, default prompts, invocation policies
Registry, pinned sources, assets, provider integrations, permissions
Resource-URI invention, new owners or agents, model/provider calls, deletions
acceptance_criteria: All 37 skill interface descriptions present as nonempty 25–64 character quoted strings
Missing, empty, mistyped, duplicate, mislocated and excessive descriptions fail source validation
Existing metadata and all skill instructions unchanged
GitHub and same hosted plugin receive and read back the same package
evidence_boundary: A valid field and successful publication do not prove ordinary-ChatGPT registration or welcome behavior; post-update client verification remains NOT_RUN until actually observed.
separate_followup: Current directory submission docs also specify a 64-character namespaced-identity limit exceeded by three existing specialist IDs. Rename is excluded because stable IDs are protected; this patch claims required-description coverage only, not full directory-submission certification.
